description: The manifest an agent that stores no results posts (ToolCallLedger.unstoredForLoop), for the calls given. Java (ToolCallLedgerUnstoredTest) builds each manifest from the calls and compares it to manifest; Go (fitness-runner evidence tests) reads the same manifest. listedCalls is how many [CALL tool=...] lines the runner counts (-1: at least one); incomplete is whether the runner must not check a run holding it. Regenerate the manifests with UPDATE_UNSTORED_MANIFESTS=1 in agent-runtime.

cases.name: a result that fits
cases.manifest:
[WORKSPACE agent=obs-advisor calls=1 errors=0 stored=no]
[CALL tool=artifact_select args={"q": "events"} type=text/plain bytes=15 rows=unknown error=false stored=no]
[RESULT]
node-a NotReady
[END RESULT]
